parsed.modern: Dems. Let RD, RB (fig. 8.) be two diverging rays incident upon the concave surface BD, as supposed in Case 4.; where it was demonstrated that FB is to RB as CF to CR. But in the present case RB and CR are equal, because R is supposed to be the focus of parallel rays; therefore FB and FC are so too. Which cannot be unless F be taken at an infinite distance from B; that is, unless the reflected rays BF and DF be parallel. Q. E. D.
